comparison.objective: Replace an open mug of tea with a lidded cup for a person with dementia, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe vessel transport and swapping, potentially with spill avoidance; no adjustment tool, collar, or dynamic-cycle operation.
comparison.success_condition: Lidded cup replaces the open mug; detailed placement/spill thresholds are absent. Candidate requires two qualified impacts after physical relocking.
comparison.reason: Assistive object substitution and liquid-safety handling are not damper tuning.
